section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the shift in body image research from a pathology-oriented focus on negative body image to examining positive body image. The authors reference Avalos et al.'s (2005) development of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and outline three extensions needed: examining the BAS in internationally diverse populations (specifically Germany), validating it for men (not just women), and testing it in community samples (not just college students). The present study aims to conduct a translation and validation of a German version of the BAS with male and female community samples.
